subject: Support allocation for TinkerBridge hackweek (compute + promo)
messages:
From: Alex Cheng <alex@tinkerbridge.org>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: TinkerBridge hackweek — compute & promo request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking a look. TinkerBridge is running its third annual community hackweek (Dec 14-18). We expect ~120 participants and ~30 project teams; last year ~35% used hosted inference.

Request: compute credits + promotional support to cover inference for demos and a small marketing match. Attached is a short spreadsheet with estimated token usage and a rough schedule. High-level ask: 150k inference credits + 100 GPU hours (burst) + a co-branded blog mention and social posts.

What we need from Redwood by Dec 8: confirmation of credit amount, SOW or acknowledgement for our procurement, and the promotional blurb. Doable?

Attachment: TinkerBridge-Compute-Request-2026.xlsx (xlsx)

Happy to hop on a quick call.

— Alex Cheng
Program Director, TinkerBridge
alex@tinkerbridge.org
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cheng <alex@tinkerbridge.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TinkerBridge hackweek — compute & promo request

Alex —

Thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. I looped in Marissa (community grants) and Lauren (partnership ops) to scope the ask and confirm what we can commit quickly. Early read: the request looks reasonable; we should be able to support a combined package.

Next steps: Marissa, can you propose a breakdown (token credits vs GPU hours) and whether we do a matched marketing mention? Lauren, please advise on SOW / procurement paperwork timing. I'll hold a provisional approval for up to 200k token credits and 160 GPU hours pending sign-off.

If that's acceptable to you, Alex, we'll follow up with a short SOW and a DocuSign link.

— Marcus
Head of Community Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TinkerBridge hackweek — compute & promo request

Thanks Marcus. I reviewed the attached estimates. Suggested allocation to keep margin for demos and final-day showcases:

- Token credits: 175,000 inference-credit units (redeemable during event window)
- GPU hours: 120 reserved hours + 40 burst hours (total 160; reserve + burst match your provisional)
- Marketing: co-branded blog + one sponsored tweet + swoop into our community newsletter (we can provide copy)

Conditions: credits are for public projects only (no private enterprise workloads) and we require a short attribution in participant materials. We should ask TinkerBridge to accept the SOW and confirm procurement contact.

I'll draft the SOW today (using our partnership template) and attach it.

Attachment: Draft-SOW-TinkerBridge.docx (docx)

— Marissa
Community Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TinkerBridge hackweek — compute & promo request

All —

Finance will need a short PO/acknowledgement and the SOW completed before we push credits. I've looped in external billing (finance@redwoodbilling.com) to confirm blackout windows and invoicing for any overages. Action items I own:

1) Finalize SOW with Marissa and convert to DocuSign-ready PDF.
2) Confirm credit provisioning window (Dec 13–19) and burst policy.
3) Send a short risk checklist to Alex (data/privacy + allowed workloads).

Marissa: once the SOW is ready, can you copy the attribution language into the marketing blurb?

— Lauren
Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cheng <alex@tinkerbridge.org>, TinkerBridge Org <orgs@tinkerbridge.org>, Samir Patel <samir@openhack.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 17:43:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: TinkerBridge hackweek support package + next steps

Alex / TinkerBridge team —

Good news: Redwood will provide the following for TinkerBridge hackweek (Dec 14–18):

- 175,000 inference-credit units (redeemable during Dec 13–19 window)
- 120 reserved GPU hours + 40 burst GPU hours (total 160)
- Co-branded blog post + one sponsored social post + mention in our community newsletter

Attachments: Draft-SOW-TinkerBridge.docx (attached)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/tinkerbridge-sow (please sign by Dec 8)

Conditions / notes:
- Credits are intended for community/open projects; enterprise/private workloads require separate procurement.
- Overages will be charged per our standard hosting rates; finance will follow up with PO/invoice options.
- We request a short quote / organizer blurb for the blog by Dec 10 to meet our content calendar.

Marissa / Lauren / Soojin are copied for operational follow-up. Finance (finance@redwoodbilling.com) will reach out about PO details.

Alex — if that aligns, sign the SOW and we'll provision the credits the day before the event. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if useful.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Community Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Draft-SOW-TinkerBridge.docx (docx)
